verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Inference Providers pricing (pass-through provider rates, bring-your-own key, monthly usage view, org billing header), but nothing documents rate limits or how they scale across usage tiers. Rate-limit documentation is a fair question for an API platform, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production
